apply_color_jitter: apply random brightness, contrast, and saturation jitter to a numpy image array
random_sized_crop_image: perform random sized crop on an image with 8 to 100 percent area and resize to target size
scale_image_short_side: scale an image so its shortest side matches a given target size using cv2 resize
random_crop_list: perform random crop on a list of images with optional padding and bounding box adjustment
apply_lighting_pca_jitter: apply AlexNet-style PCA lighting jitter to an image using eigenvalues and eigenvectors
